units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:2:2">Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ</cite> top <he>והן … שיש ברְדִיפָתוֹ וכ׳</he> and they judge that in his (the ox’s) pursuit of an animal lies the intention to gore.—Pl. <cite ref="T00950"><he>רְדִיפוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:2:2">Ib.</cite> <he>רדף שלש ר׳</he> if he ran after an animal three times.
